meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research and the beui.dev interaction catalog. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, interaction, micro-interaction, make it feel alive, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计优质前端界面，整合品牌与性能标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要构建美观且高性能的前端界面
copy.tagline_en: Design high-quality frontend UI with brand and performance standards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build beautiful and high-performance frontend UI

howto.what: 当你提出前端相关需求时，Claude会自动加载设计规则、品牌参考、性能检测和交互指南，先建立设计系统再编码，并确保产出达到专业水准，通过视觉比对和性能审计。
howto.when: 当你提到前端、UI、UX、设计、React、Lighthouse等关键词，或者要求重新设计页面、优化性能、检查可访问性时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个类似Linear风格的登录页面，并生成DESIGN.md。
say.note: Claude会加载对应品牌规则，先创建设计系统再编码。

say.text: 检查这个React组件的性能，优化到Lighthouse满分。
say.note: Claude会运行Playwright审计并诊断根因。

say.text: 查找深蓝色和白色的配色方案，适合企业网站。
say.note: Claude会查询ui-ux-db数据库给出推荐。

howto.what_en: When you make a frontend request, Claude loads design rules, brand references, performance checks, and interaction guides. It creates a design system first, then implements code, ensuring output meets professional standards through visual QA and audits.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like frontend, UI, UX, design, React, Lighthouse, or ask to redesign, optimize performance, or check accessibility.

say_en.text: Design a Linear-style login page with a DESIGN.md.
say_en.note: Claude loads brand rules, creates design system then code.

say_en.text: Audit this React component and make it reach perfect Lighthouse score.
say_en.note: Claude runs Playwright audit and fixes root causes.

say_en.text: Find a color palette with dark blue and white for a corporate site.
say_en.note: Claude queries the ui-ux-db database for recommendations.
